descriptions.w3d_ai_push_scaled_trajectory_8001080c: Scales a trajectory and submits its result to the plan queue.
descriptions.w3d_ai_execute_trajectory_8001084c: Executes a plan with fixed trajectory parameters.
descriptions.w3d_ai_reset_trajectory_time_800108b8: Resets the trajectory time before executing the plan.
descriptions.w3d_ai_score_trajectory_80010920: Refreshes weapon data and scales the trajectory score.
descriptions.w3d_ai_execute_weapon_80010f34: Executes a weapon plan with fixed parameters.
descriptions.w3d_ai_weapon_damage_80010f60: Returns adjusted damage from the cached weapon.
descriptions.w3d_ai_query_sheep_80010ff8: Queries sheep speed and distance for the plan.
descriptions.w3d_ai_query_radius_80011058: Queries the cached weapon radius with mode zero.
descriptions.w3d_ai_query_radius_alt_800110ac: Queries the cached weapon radius with mode one.
descriptions.w3d_ai_execute_sheep_80011344: Executes a sheep plan and appends an actor command to a new queue.
